problems: The card asks for a wide curved brim, but in the render the brim reads as a flat oval disk. The 0.09 upturn and the 0.025 wave are lost in the three-quarter view, and the silhouette and rim line look flat. The fix makes the curl stronger and more concentrated at the edge, and raises the wave, so the rim visibly lips up and undulates.

The brim reads as a deep bowl or saucer, not a wide hat brim. The curl lifts the edge 0.17 (plus a 0.045 wave) across the outer half, so the whole brim slopes steeply and its dark outer underside shows as a thick wall. A witch-hat brim should stay mostly flat and turn up only in a short lip at the very edge.
The strong cos(2a) wave makes the brim look elliptical and lopsided: the right side rises well above the left. It should be a gentle ripple.
